_about: Decision thresholds and evidence weights of the second-opinion review (src/scamshield/review/policy.py). Override the whole file with SCAMSHIELD_REVIEW_POLICY=<path>.
_history_about: Days of independently recorded history: registration record, first certificate in certificate transparency, first capture in the Internet Archive. The longest record counts.
_points_about: Positive evidence of legitimacy. External points come from records the site cannot write itself; page points come from the site's own pages and are capped, so a copied site cannot clear itself.
_outcomes_about: Overturn (allow) and downgrade (warn) need both a total and a minimum of external points. Overturn needs proven ownership, five years of history, or two years plus a top-sites rank: an aged domain alone can be bought. Without a standing accusation and with no sensitive data collected, a site whose identity matches its domain may be downgraded on page evidence alone.
_blocklist_about: A blocklist hit is only softened, never cleared: a long-established genuine business listed on a feed is most likely a past compromise.
_providers_about: A form posting to another host is the site's own business when the host is a known form / payment / booking service (intel services.business_form_hosts), a popular domain in the top-sites list, or an account named after the site on a ranked provider.
_soft_about: Engine reasons that are weak on their own (model scores, address features, certificates, pressure words, scrambled or protective scripts). Any other reason without a dedicated test leaves the block in place unless refuted.
_judge_about: An LLM judge may only move the rule outcome towards caution, and never from a cleared site back to a block on its own word (policy.bound).
_ownership_about: Wikidata and the DuckDuckGo panel can be edited by anyone. They prove ownership only together with a second source of another kind (the other panel, the top-sites list), or when the Wikidata item has at least this many Wikipedia articles. The brand registry and the allowlist are curated and count alone.
